channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill five, cause power outages in five regions
item.description: A Ukrainian official says attacks on Zaporizhia and Dnipropetrovsk regions damaged a number of energy sites.

item.title: Fire breaks out following drone strikes on a residential area in Al Damazin
item.description: Flames seen engulfing a house in Sudan’s Blue Nile state, following a large-scale drone strike carried out by the RSF.

item.title: Israeli strike in Gaza kills senior Hamas official, his wife and children
item.description: Gaza's internal security director and his family are among seven Palestinians killed in one day by Israeli forces.

item.title: My family were killed in Ukraine. My mum blamed Zelensky's troops - the truth is complicated
item.description: BBC journalist Anastasiya Gribanova investigates who killed her father and grandparents in the war.

item.title: Colombian police storm supermarket to free 20 held hostage for 17 hours
item.description: One gunman was killed in the operation to free around 20 shoppers and employees after a 17-hour hostage ordeal.

item.title: Israeli air strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza
item.description: Naeem Abu Nahel, who had been in the post for two months, is among seven Palestinians reportedly killed in Israeli strikes on Tuesday.
